description: This file contains shell functions related to testing a library script, specifically functions to write, run, and validate sub-tests for the 'test-lib.sh' library in a bash environment.

methods.name: write_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Creates a test script for testing the test-library, setting up a directory and writing a script that sources 'test-lib.sh'.

methods.name: _run_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Executes a common routine for running sub-tests, handling test arguments, environment setup, and capturing output.

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Combines writing a test script and executing a successful test run.

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Combines writing a test script and executing a failing test run.

methods.name: _check_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Checks that the output matches the expected output after manipulating the output file.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Verifies that the test output matches the expected output and that no error output occurred.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Verifies that the test output and error output match the expected output.
